QuestInfo.name: Simply Peachy
QuestInfo.0: There is something wrong with Tae Sang who runs the Mu Lung Training Center. Go speak with Tae Sang.
QuestInfo.1: Tae Sang is concerned because the #r#o2600314##k have been eating up all the Peach that covers much of the Training Ground's operating costs. Go teach #r#o2600314##k a lesson so that they do not mess with the Peach again.
QuestInfo.2: You have taught #r#o2600314##k a lesson so that they don't take the Peach that helps the operating costs of the Mu Lung Training Center as Tae Sang requested.

0.0: It takes a lot of money to feed and clothe these trainees. Lucky for us, the peaches around Mu Lung are so sweet that people say that gods themselves used to eat them.
0.1: But these pesky #r#o2600314##k monsters are eating up all the peaches! We need those peaches to cover the cost of running this place. Please help us.

yes.0: Teach those #r#o2600314##k monsters a lesson. Maybe get #r40 #o2600314##k to scare the rest off.

no.0: Yeah? Well, you'll be the first to go when we run out of money.

yes.0: It's really easy to scare #o2600314# monsters. Show them you're not to be messed with, and you'll teach the crew a lesson!
